name: ExergyNet Omega Carrier MCP
description: Authenticated remote SSE MCP gateway for ExergyNet persistent memory, bounded evidence retrieval, AERIS zkTLS witnessing, and EIP-191 signed memory receipts. Also distributes two local stdio MCP packages on npm: @lnes/vanguard-memory-node (2.1.0, 13 tools) and exergynet-mcp-server (0.2.6, 5 read-only tools).
endpoint_status: remote SSE live at https://mcp.exergynet.org/sse (Bearer auth required); legacy https://exergynet.org/mcp endpoint retired/disabled
